$comment: Machine-readable contract for everything this project assumes about
jav8.vip, and for the download-client defaults.
The userscript has to ship as a single file, so these values are inlined
in the script. test/parity.test.mjs asserts the inlined copies match this
file, so they cannot drift apart silently.
The jav-scraper project (Python) implements the same site knowledge
separately, in user_modules/scraper.py and user_modules/downloaders.py.
Language differs so no code is literally shared, but the facts below are
the shared contract - see README.md for how each was measured.

notes: The site injects promotional cards with absolute hrefs via its adworker
script. Requiring the /v/ prefix on the card selector skips them.
Studio-strip cards have no cover image and get no tick box.

selectors.$comment: CSS selectors verified against captured pages in test/fixtures.

$comment: 1024-based on purpose: the site labels GiB as GB almost everywhere, and
one consistent basis keeps every window comparison self-consistent.
The rule is: title marker OR a VR substring in the code prefix.
Measured disagreement between the two signals is the reason both are
needed: the title marker caught 17/17 known VR releases, the code
pattern caught 6 more that the title missed, and the code pattern
produced zero false positives across 98 flat releases.
A hand-listed set of prefixes was tried first and caught only 6 of 26,
so it is deliberately not used.
Do not treat 第一人称 (first person) as a VR signal: it appears on many
ordinary flat releases.
A meaningful share of magnet entries are adverts. Across 262 real
entries the three tiers below separate them cleanly: no clean release
matched an ad rule, and no advert escaped one.
The bare @ is deliberate. An earlier rule required a domain after it
and so missed real entries such as 第一會所新片@SIS001@DDH-451 and
ALDN-433.[4K]@R90s, where nothing follows the @ but a dotted domain.

ad.wordsPattern: (夸克|無广告|无广告|旗舰APP|成人APP|1视频|月新地址)

suspect.note: Deprioritised, used only when no clean release exists.

clean.note: A plain catalog name such as IPZZ-961 or 259LUXU-1900.

$comment: Order of preference, and why the largest wins inside the window.
See pickMagnet() in the userscript.
rule: clean magnets whose size is inside the window
if the window excludes every clean magnet, the largest clean one, flagged outside-window
if there are no clean magnets, a suspect one rather than nothing

$comment: Stock-install defaults for the products, shown as placeholders in the
settings form. These are publicly documented product defaults, not
credentials. Only what a user types is persisted.
These same defaults exist in jav-scraper as
user_modules/downloaders.py::VENDOR_DEFAULTS.

aria2.auth: params[0] = 'token:<secret>' when a secret is set
aria2.note: No CORS headers, so GM_xmlhttpRequest is required.

qbittorrent.auth: SID cookie from the login response
note: Set-Cookie is a forbidden header name for a plain fetch and is not
surfaced by every userscript manager, so a missing SID falls back to
relying on the manager's cookie jar rather than failing outright.
